params.message:
Serve category icons as bytes; an unreadable icon is a logged 404, not a 500

simple_image() re-encoded every file on the default disk through
Intervention/GD, so an icon GD could not decode threw "Image source not
readable" as an unhandled 500. It now serves the bytes with their own
mime, keeps SVG as image/svg+xml, and answers 404 with a log line naming
the path for anything missing, empty or not an image. The file is read
with get() instead of exists(), so the bucket is not asked for a
directory listing (R S1-6.38).
